name: nefrotrack
description: NefroTrack — Centros de Hemodiálisis, Reuso de Capilares (FFV >= 80%), Ósmosis Inversa & Módulos PAMI/INCUCAI

scripts.version:bump: node -e "import('fs').then(fs => { const v = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('version.json')); const [maj, min, patch] = v.version.replace('v', '').split('.').map(Number); const nextPatch = String(patch + 1).padStart(2, '0'); v.version = 'v' + maj + '.' + min + '.' + nextPatch; v.build = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10).replace(/-/g, '') + '.1'; v.releaseDate = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10); v.cacheName = 'nefrotrack-cache-' + v.version; fs.writeFileSync('version.json', JSON.stringify(v, null, 2)); console.log('Bumped to ' + v.version); })"
